MAC regular season champions |tourney = [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result= First Round }} {{2021–22 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Toledo]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Rockets, led by 12th-year head coach [[Tod Kowalczyk]], played their home games at [[Savage Arena]], as members of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 26-8, 17-3 in [[2021–22 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC Play]] to finish as regular season champions. They defeated [[2021–22 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Central Michigan]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to Akron. As a No. 1 seed who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]].{{cite web|title=Holmes scores 20 to lift Dayton over Toledo 74-55 in NIT|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401411707|accessdate=March 21, 2022|publisher=ESPN}} ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Rockets]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 21–9, 15–4 in MAC play to win MAC regular season championship. They defeated [[2020–21 Ball State Cardinals men's basketball team|Ball State]] in the first round of the [[2021 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before losing to eventual tournament champions [[2020–21 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team|Ohio]] in the second round. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost to [[2020–21 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]] in the first round.{{Cite web|title=Toledo vs. Richmond – Game Recap – March 17, 2021 – ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311773|access-date=2021-12-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
